geography.basis: Reported localities and a later satellite scar give documentary context. Neither supplies registered minute positions or an Atlas geographic replay. Three retained county segments have an explicit beginning/continuation narrative and matching source boundaries. They remain separate records with EF2, EF5 and EF2 ratings, rather than a new surveyed continuous route.

appearance.basis: The linked tornado photograph supplies documentary visual context. Its inspection record does not establish a registered camera, clock or appearance interval.

damage.basis: Building cases and aftermath images describe surveyed or reported outcomes. Surviving areas do not establish who sheltered there, and a failure interpretation is not a timed observation of collapse. Regional utility restoration and internal hospital services remain investigation-reported, with different exposure and no assigned building impact clocks or controlled design comparison. Two separate agency StoryMap photographs show hospital surroundings and major school damage. They do not identify refuge areas, time service failures or supply a controlled comparison of winds and construction.

gaps.basis: The storm photograph inception-field conflict, unverified aftermath and housing clocks, and the radar report conversion inconsistency remain separate attributed records. None changes the admitted NWS documentary chronology. Provider temporary-care dates and facility labels remain separate attributed descriptions with unresolved correspondence. Reported whole-track lengths of nearly 21.6 and 22.1 miles remain attributed alternatives. Reported county-record clocks do not recover a physical dissipation instant or independently align an optical source.
